phaseName: Phase 4: Public Doctor Directory Pages & API
goal: Build the public-facing doctor search and profile pages.
summary: Phase 4 public directory is complete: /doctors search page with filters, /doctors/[slug] profile page with BMDC/degrees/experience/fee/chambers/schedule, custom 404, and a real next-available slot calculation that returns a future date string.
stepSummaries:
1. Create the doctor search page at `/doctors` with specialty/area/name filters and server-side data fetching. [verified]
  2. Create the doctor profile page at `/doctors/[slug]` with BMDC, degrees, experience, fee, chambers, and next-available schedule; unknown slugs return 404. [verified]
  3. Implement next-available schedule calculation from Chamber.schedules and display it on profile cards/pages. [verified]
